# 75361 - MOS driver

Package DIP-14 · family 751xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75361.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75361.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 45 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75361 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75361.png) | ![75361 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-75361.png) | ![75361 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-75361.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC1 | power |  | +5 V |
| 8 | VCC2 | power |  | +20 V nominal (4.75-24 V); MOS output supply |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 1 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 2 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 6 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 9 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 11 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 13 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 3 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 5 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 4 | E | input |  | enable common to both drivers (input of both NAND gates) |
| 12 | 1Y | output | totem-pole | MOS-level output swinging to near VCC2 |
| 10 | 2Y | output | totem-pole | MOS-level output |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 1Y = NOT (1A AND E) | Datasheet positive logic Y = (AE)'. Output high is close to VCC2. |
| 10 | 2Y = NOT (2A AND E) | Same for driver 2. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputMaxVoltageV | 24 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC1 4.75-5.25 V, VCC2 4.75-24 V (nominal 20 V), TA 0-70 C. VOH min VCC2-1 V at IOH -50 uA, VCC2-2.3 V at -10 mA; VOL max 0.3 V at IOL 10 mA, 0.5 V at 40 mA (VCC2 15-24 V). Output clamp VCC2+1.5 V. Inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V; IIL A -1.6 mA, E -3.2 mA. outputMaxVoltageV is the VCC2 maximum. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC1 5 V, VCC2 20 V, TA 25 C, CL 390 pF, RD 10 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Min ns | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or E | Y | PLH | 10 | 36 | 55 |
| A or E | Y | PHL | 10 | 31 | 47 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin |
|---|---|
| delayTime | Y |
| transitionTime | Y |

## Not known

- No recommended IOL/IOH are given; output figures exist only as VOH/VOL test conditions (in notes), so the current fields are null.
- Datasheet read is the SN75361A (tentative 1973 sheet); a datasheet for a plain SN75361 was not found.

## Sources

- [TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, SN75361A dual TTL-to-MOS driver (bulletin DL-S 7312054, Sep 1973, tentative data sheet)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1974_TI_The_Interface_Data_Book_for_Design_Engineers_Second_Edition.pdf) - 5-15 to 5-17 (PDF pages 183-185); SN75361A

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
